name: Savior
overview: The Bible reveals Jesus Christ as our Savior, the promised Messiah born in the city of David to bring salvation to the world. Isaiah foretells the revelation of the Lord’s saving power, while Luke celebrates God as Savior and announces Christ’s birth as the fulfillment of this hope. John emphasizes that salvation comes through belief in Jesus, the only way to the Father and the source of eternal life. Peter calls for repentance and baptism in Jesus’ name for the forgiveness of sins and the gift of the Holy Spirit, underscoring the necessity of turning to Christ as Savior.
